course_name_original: Schlüsselquali Fikation 2: Fachspra Che (Deutsch / Engli Sch)
prerequisites: For Technical English: English language proficiency at B2 level, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR).

For Technical German: German language skills are assessed through a placement test at the start of the study. Depending on the result, students are assigned to a course corresponding to their language level. After successful completion of a course, students can attend a consecutive German course in the following semester.

learning_outcomes.text: Students master the English language at a secure B2 level (CEFR) and can understand technical discussions in the field of Artificial Intelligence.
They possess skills to understand technical literature and produce texts independently at a B2 level.
Students have knowledge of linguistic expressions at B2 level in formal and professional contexts.
They understand discussions and more complex content in their field of specialization.
They acquire the ability to functionally apply grammatical structures in their future professional fields.
They are able to give understandable and detailed presentations on relevant topics in Artificial Intelligence. Their own opinions, as well as different viewpoints, can be clearly presented.
Students expand their language acquisition skills by reflecting on their individual learning styles.
They can filter information from various English sources and process it for presentations.
Students train their social competencies in teamwork, reliability, and integrity.
They possess communicative skills by collaboratively developing solutions.
They reflect on their learning experiences from independent projects and teamwork.

syllabus_topics: Case Studies (e.g., Alan Turing, Cybersecurity, AI)
Writing Skills (e.g., Business Correspondence, Software Documentation)
assessment_rules: The module examination is a written examination of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
